## The claim

P4-19: the child's BUB1B missense allele is predicted abundance-lowering (destabilising), which is the class the raise-BubR1 direction (D3) needs

**Prediction if true.** its predicted ddG falls in the most destabilising 20% of all possible BubR1 missense substitutions and the E1 classifier calls it abundance-lowering

**What would refute it.** its ddG falls in the least destabilising 50% of all possible substitutions, or the classifier calls it function-impairing
